video.title: How Photosynthesis Works
video.style: Dynamic Remotion Motion Graphics referencing SKILL.md

scenes.title: Solar Energy Captured by Chlorophyl
scenes.subtitle: Chlorophyll pigments absorb solar photons to excite reaction center electrons.
scenes.visual_direction: Macro camera push into a luminous 3D thylakoid membrane disk; glowing golden photon waves strike chlorophyll pigment clusters, triggering radiating emerald shockwaves toward the reaction center.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Spring-damped scale entrance for the headline title, followed by staggered particle ripple animations across chlorophyll nodes and an active counter tick up to 98%.
scenes.continuity_to_next: A luminous excited electron orb pulls focus and zooms down directly into the catalytic core of Photosystem II.

scenes.title: Water Split by Catalytic Photolysis
scenes.subtitle: Photosystem II splits water molecules to supply electrons and liberate oxygen.
scenes.visual_direction: Cutaway molecular diagram of Photosystem II showing water entering the oxygen-evolving cluster; bonds snap cleanly as O2 bubbles disperse outward and protons concentrate in the lumen.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Path draw-on representing the chemical cleavage vector, simultaneous radial burst of O2 particles, and dynamic coordinate shift as protons slide into the lower chamber.
scenes.continuity_to_next: The four freed electrons align horizontally and accelerate along a glowing neon membrane pathway into the electron transport chain.

continuity.toNext: The four freed electrons align horizontally and accelerate along a glowing neon membrane pathway into the electron transport chain.

scenes.title: Electron Cascade Drives Proton Grad
scenes.subtitle: Electrons flow through cytochrome b6f, pumping protons across the thylakoid membrane.
scenes.visual_direction: Dynamic lateral tracking shot moving left-to-right following mobile carriers, with vertical neon arrows showing protons actively propelled from stroma into the lumen space.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Continuous kinetic wave bezier motion connecting node to node; pulsed glow indicators sync with each electron handoff across protein complexes.
scenes.continuity_to_next: The dense accumulation of glowing lumen protons concentrates into a high-pressure funnel pointing directly into the rotor of ATP synthase.

continuity.toNext: The dense accumulation of glowing lumen protons concentrates into a high-pressure funnel pointing directly into the rotor of ATP synthase.

scenes.title: ATP and NADPH Chemical Powerhouses
scenes.subtitle: Chemiosmotic force synthesizes ATP while terminal electrons produce reducing NADPH.
scenes.visual_direction: Split-composition engineering view: on the left, ATP synthase head spins mechanically emitting glowing ATP crystals; on the right, FNR binds NADP+ and releases pulsing gold NADPH capsules into the stroma.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Continuous rotational transformation on the ATP synthase headpiece coupled with explosive outward spring pop-ins of freshly synthesized ATP and NADPH molecules.
scenes.continuity_to_next: A fleet of radiant ATP and NADPH molecules drifts upward out of the thylakoid into the fluid stromal environment.

scenes.title: RuBisCO Fixes Atmospheric Carbon Di
scenes.subtitle: The enzyme RuBisCO covalently joins carbon dioxide onto ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate.
scenes.visual_direction: Orbital circular composition featuring a prominent RuBisCO macromolecular model at center; CO2 molecules spiral in from the atmosphere and fuse into RuBP, cleanly cleaving into identical 3-PGA nodes.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Smooth 360-degree orbital rotation of reactant rings, snapping into the central active site pocket with an elastic scale impact on covalent binding.
scenes.continuity_to_next: The paired 3-PGA molecules enter a circular conveyor track where waiting ATP and NADPH from Scene 4 lock onto them.

scenes.title: Glucose Synthesized From Triose Pho
scenes.subtitle: Triose phosphates export to assemble stable hexose glucose while resetting RuBP.
scenes.visual_direction: Wide cinematic macro pullback: two G3P molecules interlock in the foreground to form a sparkling crystalline six-carbon glucose ring, while behind it the complete Calvin loop gracefully spins and resets.
scenes.narration: Inside plant chloroplasts, photosynthesis transforms sunlight into chemical life. Antenna chlorophyll pigments absorb ph
scenes.motion_cue: Geometric morphing transition as linear triose molecules snap-fold into a hexagonal glucose ring, illuminated by a warm outward volumetric light bloom.
scenes.continuity_to_next: The illuminated glucose ring stabilizes and pulses as the grand energetic cycle achieves equilibrium.
